events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: English actor, comedian, screenwriter, and producer John Cleese, known for Monty Python and Fawlty Towers, turns 87.

angles.name: Comedy Legend
angles.copy: John Cleese is 87 today! From Monty Python's Flying Circus to Fawlty Towers, his unique brand of humour has kept us laughing for decades. What's your favourite Cleese moment?

events.title: The Beatles' 'White Album' released in 1968
events.blurb: The Beatles' ninth studio album, officially titled 'The Beatles' but commonly known as the 'White Album', was released on this day in 1968.

angles.name: Iconic Double Album
angles.copy: On this day in 1968, The Beatles unleashed the iconic 'White Album' upon the world. A sprawling, eclectic masterpiece that broke all the rules. What's your go-to track from this legendary double album?

events.title: Remembering Freddie Mercury
events.blurb: Today marks the anniversary of the death of Queen frontman Freddie Mercury, who would have been 80.

angles.name: Legendary Voice
angles.copy: Remembering the one and only Freddie Mercury, who would have been 80 today. His voice, stage presence, and songwriting changed music forever. A true legend, never forgotten.

events.title: The Beatles' 'Rubber Soul' released in 1965
events.blurb: The Beatles' sixth studio album, 'Rubber Soul', was released on this day in 1965, marking a pivotal moment in their artistic evolution.

angles.name: Folk-Rock Masterpiece
angles.copy: A true classic turns another year older! On this day in 1965, The Beatles released 'Rubber Soul', an album that saw them push new boundaries. What's your favourite track from this folk-rock masterpiece?

events.title: Remembering John Lennon
events.blurb: Today marks the anniversary of the death of The Beatles co-founder John Lennon, who would have been 86.

angles.name: Peace & Music Legacy
angles.copy: Remembering John Lennon, who would have been 86 today. His legacy of peace, love, and groundbreaking music continues to inspire. What's the John Lennon song that resonates most with you?

events.title: David Bowie would have been 80
events.blurb: Today would have been the 80th birthday of the iconic British musician, singer, and songwriter David Bowie.

angles.name: Starman's Legacy
angles.copy: Remembering David Bowie on what would have been his 80th birthday. A true innovator who constantly reinvented himself and his music. Which Bowie era is your favourite?

events.title: Elvis Presley would have been 92
events.blurb: Today would have been the 92nd birthday of the 'King of Rock and Roll', Elvis Presley.

angles.name: The King's Birthday
angles.copy: Remembering the King of Rock and Roll, Elvis Presley, who would have been 92 today. His impact on music and culture is simply unparalleled. What's your favourite Elvis track?

events.title: Jimmy Page turns 83
events.blurb: English guitarist, songwriter, and record producer Jimmy Page, best known as the founder of Led Zeppelin, turns 83.

angles.name: Guitar God
angles.copy: Happy 83rd birthday to the legendary Jimmy Page! The Led Zeppelin mastermind who gave us some of the most iconic guitar riffs in history. What's your favourite Pagey moment?

events.title: Rod Stewart turns 82
events.blurb: Sir Rod Stewart, the iconic British singer-songwriter known for his distinctive raspy voice, turns 82.

angles.name: Rock & Roll Hall of Famer
angles.copy: Happy 82nd birthday to the legendary Rod Stewart! From Faces to his incredible solo career, his voice is unmistakable. What's your favourite Rod hit?

events.title: Suggs turns 66
events.blurb: Graham McPherson, better known as Suggs, the lead singer of the iconic British ska band Madness, turns 66.

angles.name: Madness Frontman
angles.copy: Happy 66th birthday to Suggs, the inimitable frontman of Madness! The voice behind so many classic tracks. What's your favourite Madness tune?

events.title: Paul Young turns 71
events.blurb: British singer Paul Young, known for hits like 'Wherever I Lay My Hat (That's My Home)' and 'Come Back and Stay', turns 71.

angles.name: 80s Pop Icon
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 71st birthday to Paul Young! His smooth vocals defined a generation of pop. What's your favourite Paul Young classic?

events.title: Dolly Parton turns 81
events.blurb: The legendary American singer-songwriter, actress, and businesswoman Dolly Parton turns 81.

angles.name: Country Queen
angles.copy: Happy 81st birthday to the one and only Dolly Parton! A true icon, songwriter, and philanthropist. What's your go-to Dolly track?

events.title: Gary Barlow turns 56
events.blurb: English singer, songwriter, and record producer Gary Barlow, best known as the lead vocalist of Take That, turns 56.

angles.name: Take That Legend
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 56th birthday to Take That's very own Gary Barlow! A pop icon and incredible songwriter. What's your favourite Gary Barlow or Take That song?

events.title: Billy Ocean turns 77
events.blurb: Trinidadian-British singer and songwriter Billy Ocean, known for his string of international R&B and pop hits, turns 77.

angles.name: Caribbean Queen
angles.copy: Happy 77th birthday to the fantastic Billy Ocean! His soulful voice gave us some of the biggest hits of the 70s and 80s. What's your favourite Billy Ocean anthem?

events.title: Rock and Roll Hall of Fame first induction (1989)
events.blurb: The first-ever induction ceremony for the Rock and Roll Hall of Fame was held on this day in 1989, honouring rock's pioneers.

angles.name: Hall of Fame History
angles.copy: On this day in 1989, the Rock and Roll Hall of Fame held its inaugural induction ceremony. A significant moment in music history! Who do you think should be inducted next?

events.title: Mark Owen turns 55
events.blurb: English singer-songwriter Mark Owen, a member of the pop group Take That, turns 55.

angles.name: Pop Star Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 55th birthday to Take That's Mark Owen! From boyband heartthrob to solo artist, he's been a pop fixture for decades. What's your favourite Mark Owen moment?

events.title: The Beatles' iconic rooftop concert (1969)
events.blurb: On this day in 1969, The Beatles performed their legendary impromptu rooftop concert on the roof of the Apple Corps building in London, their final public performance.

angles.name: Legendary Rooftop Gig
angles.copy: 58 years ago today, The Beatles made history with their iconic rooftop concert in London. An unforgettable moment in music! If you could have been there, which song would you have wanted to hear live?

events.title: Phil Collins turns 76
events.blurb: English drummer, singer, songwriter, and record producer Phil Collins, known for his work with Genesis and his successful solo career, turns 76.

angles.name: Drumming Legend
angles.copy: Happy 76th birthday to the one and only Phil Collins! A drumming powerhouse and a voice behind countless hits. What's your favourite Phil Collins or Genesis track?
